thread:
Alex: Heads up — I'm planning an OTEL collector change to reduce high-cardinality in spans. Main goals: drop raw prompts, keep hashed identifiers for correlation, and provide a tiny sampled path for full prompt retention for evals.
Tanya: +1 on dropping raw prompts. Quick Q: do we keep user_id hashed or remove entirely? billing needs a stable identifier per user.
Alex: keep user_id but hash with a per-environment salt (KMS-managed). That gives a stable pseudonym while preventing raw PII.
Jorge: watch BigQuery schemas — if we change attribute names it can break existing dashboards. Can we map instead of removing?
Alex: plan is to rename prompt -> prompt_hash and make prompt_text removed by default. We'll keep prompt_hash as string(64). Existing dashboards should read prompt_hash opaque.
Priya: Console needs request_id to stitch traces <> logs for the SLA dashboard. Can we keep request_id but hash it?
Alex: yes, keep request_id but hash, and also retain a short debug_token for live debugging that expires in 24h. debug_token will be stored only in the secure bucket.
Sam: sampling strategy for full prompts? we still need examples for quality regressions and evals.
Alex: sample 0.1% of requests for full prompt capture to secure GCS (encrypted), rotation 90d. Also provide an opt-in via support flow for higher retention on specific customers.
Tanya: does OTEL collector support salt+hash in an attribute processor? we currently run the collector as a sidecar + central collector pipeline.
Alex: yes — we'll use the attribute processor + processor/hash and a processor/experimental/scrubber to drop specific keys. Draft config below.
Alex: ```
processors:
  hash/user_id:
    actions:
      - key: user.id
        action: hash
        salt_kms_key: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/telemetry-salt
  scrub/prompts:
    actions:
      - key: prompt_text
        action: delete
  sample/full_prompt:
    probabilistic_sampling:
      rate: 0.001
exporters:
  secure_gcs:
    bucket: telemetry-secure-prompts-prod
    encrypt_with_kms: projects/redwood/.../telemetry-enc
  bigquery:
    dataset: telemetry_v2
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [hash/user_id, scrub/prompts, sample/full_prompt]
      exporters: [bigquery, secure_gcs]
```
Jorge: looks good. For BigQuery we should also add a schema migration job that tolerates missing prompt_text. I'll prep a migration script.
Priya: important: add a fallback for on-call debugging — if debug_token matches, collector should allow one full prompt through for 1h. Controlled by RBAC.
Alex: agreed. We'll gate via an internal header `X-Debug-Token` validated against the auth service.
infra-bot: FYI — collector v1.11 has hashing processor as experimental on staging only.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled: otel-collector v1.12 -> staging at 2026-03-18T15:10Z
Sam: timeline? can we roll this out in a canary lane and monitor cardinality metrics?
Alex: plan: canary to 5% of traces for 48h, monitor unique attribute counts + alert if scrubbed attr still appears. If green, 24h full roll. I'll add feature flag + rollout dashboard.
Tanya: agree. Add integration test that asserts prompt_text is not present in exported BigQuery rows.
Alex: will open RFC + PR with the config and tests. tagging @Tanya @Jorge @Priya for early review.
Priya: great, also loop in support for the opt-in retention flow.
Alex: thanks — I'll post the PR link here once it's up.
